fact: Loobamub shares unease about Phylo's new ways.
source_quote: He explained that myconid hunters did not kill prey. They tracked creatures that had already died near the grove and brought the remains back for reanimation... He asked the party to kill a grick alpha lurking in the nearby fungal wilds and bring back its carcass intact. Zalthir asked why this errand mattered, and then answered his own question: a reanimated grick could fight alongside them against whatever demonic force was in the Garden of Welcome. Basidia called it "an excellent idea." Through it all, Dawnbringer blazed at Thorin's side and refused to be dimmed, a constant, chattering reminder that she had spent far too long in the dark and had absolutely no intention of ever going back.
subject: Loobamub

fact: Loobamub affirms that Phylo's new ways are not good.
source_quote: Loobamub affirms, "yes, yes, Phylo's new ways are not good."
subject: Loobamub
